issues.description: The solution implementation treats the label display_start inconsistently compared to the template/problem: in the template and problem statement display_start is the base address of the framebuffer, but in the solution set_pixel the code uses a memory dereference ([display_start]) when adding it to the computed offset. Using [display_start] reads the first 4 bytes stored at that address instead of using the address itself, producing an incorrect final pointer calculation and incorrect memory access.
issues.suggestedFix: Use the symbol address display_start (not its dereferenced content) when computing the pixel address. For example, add the immediate label (add eax, display_start) or load the label into a register (mov esi, display_start) and add that register. Ensure the same addressing convention is used consistently in both the main calculation and set_pixel.
